units.source_text: “有的女子，父母双全，爱如珍宝，娇养在深闺中，将来期望甚大；

en.t: Some young women have both parents living, are loved like precious treasures, are brought up tenderly in the inner chambers, and are expected to have great prospects in the future;

units.source_text: 男的从传闻中听到这女子的某种才艺，便倾心恋慕，也是常有的事。

en.t: and it is also common for a man, hearing through rumor of some talent such a woman possesses, to lose his heart and fall deeply in love with her.

units.source_text: 此种女子，容貌姣好，性情温顺，青春年华，闲暇无事，

en.t: Such a woman is fair in appearance, gentle in nature, young in years, and has leisure with little to occupy her,

units.source_text: 便模仿别人，专心学习琴棋书画，作为娱乐，结果自然学得了一艺之长。

en.t: so she imitates others and applies herself to music, games, calligraphy, and painting for amusement, and in the end naturally acquires skill in one art.

units.source_text: 媒人往往隐瞒了她的短处而夸张她的长处。

en.t: Matchmakers often conceal her shortcomings and exaggerate her strengths.

units.source_text: 听者虽然怀疑，总不能全凭推测而断定其为说谎。

en.t: Although the listener may be suspicious, he still cannot decide, on guesswork alone, that the matchmaker is lying.

units.source_text: 如果相信了媒妁之言，和这女子相见，终于相处，

en.t: If he believes the matchmaker's words, meets this woman, and eventually lives with her,

units.source_text: 结果很少有不教人失望的啊！”

en.t: the result is very seldom anything but disappointment!”
